item.title: Farmland Shrinks As Data Centres Expand, Raising Food Security Concerns
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
KPKM warns that farmland is being converted for data centres and other industrial purposes, raising food security risks. Livestock land shrank 48% since 2017 due to development pressures. Data centre investments reached RM144 bil from 2021 to March 2025. The post Farmland Shrinks As Data Centres Expand, Raising Food Security Concerns appeared first on CodeBlue .
Matched: policy(+3), ministry(+2), war(+3), ai(+3)

item.title: Unfair Treatment At HTJS — Houseman
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Housemen have been stuck in their medical posting at HTJS for nearly a month now. It's taking a toll on the mental health of all housemen in this hospital because not only are we behind our other batchmates, other departments are severely lacking in HOs. item.title: MOH Issuing New Circular On Junior Medical Officers’ Working Hours
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Dr Dzul says the Health DG will issue a new circular on junior medical officers' working hours, besides stressing compliance with flexi-work guidelines for housemen. Junior doctors in Malaysia work 65 to 85 hours weekly, far higher than the UK's 40 hours. The post MOH Issuing New Circular On Junior Medical Officers’ Working Hours appeared first on CodeBlue .
